_about: CELLFEE second-life application registry. Every value below is a CONFIGURED ASSUMPTION for decision support, not a measured fact or a safety standard - a domain expert should review them. min_soh is the application's safety floor (usage baseline); the training data (Severson et al. 2019) only covers health down to 80%, so floors below 0.80 cannot be validated and are not used. min_remaining_cycles is the cycle-life requirement: the battery must stay above min_soh for at least that many more full cycles. max_cycles_in_service caps the stop period regardless of the prediction.

applications.name: Light mobility (e-rickshaw / e-cycle)
applications.why: high power and daily deep cycling need strong capacity and a long life ahead

applications.name: Solar home storage
applications.why: daily cycling at low C-rate; moderate capacity is acceptable

applications.name: Telecom / UPS backup
applications.why: mostly standby, occasional discharge; tolerant of reduced capacity

applications.name: Street-light / IoT node
applications.why: small, shallow daily cycles; lowest energy requirement

applications.name: Home / residential backup (UPS)
applications.why: indoor standby use; a few full discharges a month

applications.name: Commercial & industrial peak shaving
applications.duty: one discharge per working day at peak tariff
applications.why: regular daily cycling needs capacity and cycle life

applications.name: EV charging buffer
applications.duty: high-power bursts several times a day
applications.why: high C-rate bursts need low resistance and strong health

applications.name: Microgrid / rural electrification
applications.why: daily cycling at moderate power in warm sites

applications.name: Solar water pumping / agriculture
applications.why: low-consequence load, tolerant of reduced capacity

applications.name: Cold-chain & storage backup
applications.why: spoilage risk needs dependable capacity; cells must run cool

applications.name: Data-centre / server UPS
applications.why: critical load: high power, low resistance and strong health

applications.name: Material handling (forklifts, AGVs)
applications.duty: shift-based deep cycling with opportunity charging
applications.why: heavy daily use near people; LFP only for thermal stability

applications.name: Emergency lighting
applications.why: very light duty; only needs a modest life ahead

applications.name: Portable & construction-site power
applications.why: frequent cycling on site; needs moderate health and life

skipped.name: Railway signalling backup
skipped.why: needs railway safety-integrity (SIL) certification that cell test data cannot speak to

skipped.name: Community grid support
skipped.why: needs grid-code compliance and utility-scale requirements not captured by cell-level data
